stage1.impression: A canal-side night scene with a rim-lit armillary globe of coloured rings on a dark plinth, its shadow cast as overlapping pink-violet ellipses on the paving. The globe reads as a specific, striking object, but the place reads as a render: the paving and water are smooth and uniform, the figure is a blocky placeholder mannequin, the spot's pool is a hard white disc on orange paving, and the coloured shadow, the point of the frame, is washed out. A jury would see a strong idea in a generic CG setting, not a night photograph of a work in Amsterdam.

blocking_9: The coloured shadow must read as saturated colour, not just darker paving: each disc's tint visibly distinct in the pool (hue shift, not only luminance)
No placeholder geometry: the near figure must be a real person asset or be removed
The site must read as Amsterdam: gabled brick houses with legible lit windows across the canal in frame, not a dark band cropped at the top edge
The spot's pool must sit in the same colour world as the rest of the quay (no neutral white disc on orange paving) and fall off with a soft natural edge
Paving, kerb and water need real material detail at 1:1 (worn setts, joints with grime, varied stones, ripple with broken reflections) with no visible tiling
The globe's clear faces must read as clear acrylic with reflections and edge glow, not as a dark smoked volume

defects.what: Near figure is a blocky mannequin with a disc head and rectangular body: an obvious placeholder
Coloured shadow is faint pink/violet; the tinted areas are mostly darker, not coloured (pool 142/109/97 vs tinted 103/63/65 RGB)
Spot pool is neutral grey-white (RGB ~127/127/126) with a hard theatrical edge against orange paving; reads as a stage light, not a light on a street
Far houses cropped at the top edge: Amsterdam is barely shown, just two window frames
Foreground paving is flat and uniform (lum_range 26.5), a regular repeated slab texture with no wear, grime or variation
Water is a uniform brown with soft streaky reflections; no specular ripple highlights, no sky reflection, no lamp reflections broken into glints
Globe interior reads as a dark brown smoked mass; the clear faces show little reflection or transparency, so the discs read as tinted glass panes rather than clear acrylic
Plinth is a featureless near-black cylinder (median 14.7), no blackened-steel sheen or edge highlight
Fine noise grain visible across the paving and figure at 1:1; overall orange cast with no cool counterpoint
Barrier ring posts and rope are thin uniform black rods; they clutter the shadow and read as CG

changes.problem: The hard spot's pool is a cool white disc on warm paving, so the coloured shadow is weak against it and the pool reads as stage lighting.

evidence.measured: pool RGB median 127/127/126 vs paving 70/36/20; tinted shadow 103/63/65 vs open pool 142/109/97: mostly a luminance drop, little hue

change.setting: the hard spot: colour and power; render white_balance_k
change.to: 5600 K, 1100 W; white_balance_k 3600 so the pool reads near-neutral warm white and the paving outside it less orange

changes.expected: The pool reads as clean light the colours sit on; tinted shadow patches show distinct hues (red, blue, yellow, green) with chroma, not brown-pink.

changes.problem: The spot's cone has a hard, perfectly elliptical edge that reads as a theatre follow-spot.

evidence.measured: x-profile 26.5 -> 64.8 -> 107.1 -> 43.7 with a sharp step at the pool's rim

change.setting: the hard spot: cone and blend; aim
change.from: cone 16 deg, hard edge, aimed at [0.3, -2.0, 0.0]
change.to: cone 22 deg with a 0.35 edge blend, aimed at [0.6, -1.4, 0.0] so the pool runs over the kerb toward the water

changes.expected: The pool falls off over about 40 to 60 px at this scale and carries the shadow toward the water as the card intends.

changes.problem: The near figure is a placeholder mannequin, the strongest render tell in the frame.

evidence.measured: seen at 3x: disc head, slab body, two square legs

change.from: 5 figures, two on this quay (placeholder geometry)
change.to: replace with scanned people in winter coats (one walking with a bike, one couple looking at the globe from 6 to 8 m), or remove the near one entirely

changes.expected: A sign of life that reads as real at 1:1; scale cue for the 2 m globe.

changes.problem: The camera crops the houses across the canal, so the frame does not say Amsterdam.

evidence.measured: only two window frames visible at the top edge; median 28.6

change.to: position [4.8, -8.6, 3.6], target [0.3, -1.6, 0.9], 24 mm, keep verticals level (shift lens if needed) so the gabled facades fill the top fifth

changes.expected: Globe, shadow and a row of lit canal houses read together; the jury sees the site.

changes.problem: The far facades are almost dark, so the water has nothing to reflect and the background is a brown void.

evidence.measured: lum_median 21.2, b_median 8: dull, warm, no lit windows reflected as points

change.setting: the houses across: lit windows and glow; far quay fill
change.from: 0.32 lit, glow 0.1; fill 0.4 W/m2 at 2400 K
change.to: 0.5 lit, glow 0.35 with a mix of 2700 K and 3500 K; fill 0.8 W/m2; add a cool sky at strength 0.2

changes.expected: Facades legible, window reflections in the water as broken vertical streaks; a cool counterpoint to the warm quay.

changes.problem: Paving and water are smooth CG surfaces with a regular slab pattern and soft reflections.

evidence.measured: lum_range 26.5 over the whole foreground; regular tile grid, no wear

change.to: Amsterdam brick klinkers in herringbone with per-brick colour and roughness variation, dirty joints, a damp sheen (roughness 0.35 to 0.6); water roughness 0.05 with a fine ripple normal so lamps break into glints

changes.expected: Paving reads as real at 1:1 and catches the spot with sparkle; water shows sharp highlights.

changes.problem: The barrier ring's rods and rope cross the coloured shadow and clutter the hero element.

evidence.measured: four post and rope shadows cut across the tinted ellipses

change.from: ring r 1.7 m, rope at 0.72 m, ~8 posts
change.to: remove the ring, or a low 0.3 m blackened-steel kerb ring at the plinth only

changes.expected: The coloured shadow reads as one clean drawing of the globe on the paving.

changes.problem: Grain is visible at 1:1 and the plinth crushes to a featureless black.

evidence.measured: plinth lum_median 14.7, crush_pct 0.26; noise visible on paving and figure

change.to: 512 samples, exposure 3.8; plinth blackened steel with roughness 0.4 so it picks up an edge highlight from the street lamps

changes.expected: Clean surfaces, plinth reads as steel with a rim, frame median about 45.

out_of_scope.request: Make the discs' faces clearer or less tinted so the globe interior does not read as a dark smoked mass and the shadow colours are more saturated
out_of_scope.why: The disc colours and clear rim-lit faces are fixed; if the model's acrylic is absorbing too much, that is a material-fidelity question for the owner, not a picture fix
Allowed by the card but the rims already clip slightly (globe region clip_pct 1.05); not a priority
